hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | grep -q "tests/testthat/_baselines/" && printf "%s" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Refusing to edit tests/testthat/_baselines/: these are the frozen 1e-6 regression baselines (design D18) and must not be edited or regenerated. Fix the code to match the baseline instead.\"}}" || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | grep -qE 'RcppExports[.](R|cpp)$' && jq -nc '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Refusing to hand-edit R/RcppExports.R or src/RcppExports.cpp: they are generated by Rcpp::compileAttributes() from the C++ [[Rcpp::export]] signatures. Change the C++ source, then regenerate them with the cpp-recompile skill. This hook blocks only the Edit/Write tools, so compileAttributes() run through the shell regenerates them normally."}}' || true
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in *.R|*.r) command -v air >/dev/null 2>&1 && air format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; esac; true

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in */R/*.R|R/*.R) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; if git diff -- "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^\+.*(@export|@param|@return|@inheritParams|@rdname)' || { ! git ls-files --error-unmatch "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -qE '@export|<- function' "$f" 2>/dev/null; }; then printf '%s' "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"roxygen/@export or a function signature changed in $f \u2014 run devtools::document() and check man/ and NAMESPACE drift before committing.\"}}"; fi; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in */src/*.cpp|*/src/*.h|src/*.cpp|src/*.h) printf '%s' "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"$f is compiled (Rcpp/RcppArmadillo) \u2014 invoke the cpp-recompile skill (Rcpp::compileAttributes() + load_all recompile=TRUE) before testing so you are not testing a stale .o/.so; the coefficient and C++ golden baselines will silently pass on old objects otherwise.\"}}" ;; esac; exit 0
